Set up environment
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("src/environment_set.R") #Load functions and packages
set.seed(123) #For reproducibility
```

Input files
```{r}
counts.norm = read.csv("~/Downloads/salmon.merged.gene_tpm.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
counts.norm$gene_name = NULL
counts.norm = convert_ensembl_symbol(counts.norm)
counts.norm = counts.norm[,-which(colnames(counts.norm)%in%"Undetermined_S0")]
```
